expectation: Only authorized Staff can read the timeline and the endpoint adds no writes.
Timeline order is occurredAt ascending then eventId ascending.
Opaque cursors are bound to the request and reject tampering.
Actions, results, subjects, and tags are fixed allowlists.
Raw audit metadata, reply bodies, note bodies, tokens, and sensitive fields are never returned.
Unknown audit events fail closed without returning raw metadata.
Customer APIs and customer UI cannot read the audit timeline.
